$Comment: The trophy: the Disenchanter's Grimoire coming off a Disenchanting Table. The grimoire is an item grant on the trophy table, so it is reported as station output the moment it lands and this exact-id criterion advances on it; qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX, so either table counts. Hidden until earned, announced to the server, and its Claim carries the Flair reward: {"Kind": "Flair", "Params": {"Flair": "disenchanter"}} unlocks the Disenchanter flair (Server/RpgStations/Flairs/Disenchanter.json) for the player, which re-dresses the tables' find cues and the Unmake beat of both rituals. A flair the player already holds is a no-op.
Name: Disenchanter
